note: Private RV park on the California bank of the Colorado River, about 6 mi west of Parker, AZ, with a front row of river sites on the open shore, private docks and a dog park. Many of its sites hold long-term units. --Claude
summary: Old camping.com link dead; the park now books on Hipcamp (host-claimed since May 2025): Cliff $69 / River $73 (Interior $57 is under-20-ft only). DROP CANDIDATE on price (over $50, no gateway, not a Good Sam Park). Also a Hipcamp '4WD required' tag to rule on. Riverfront kept (front row on open shore). Google 4.2/172.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE - PRICE: the cheapest night a 23-ft rig fits is $69 (Hipcamp 'Cliff Sites 153-165 Full Hookups', host price before Hipcamp's $5 service fee); River Sites $73; the only cheaper rate, $57 'Interior Sites Full Hookups', is for 'Vehicles under 20 ft'. Over US$50 with no exception: gateways.py finds none within 40 km (Joshua Tree NP 142 km), Good Sam directory good_sam false, no operator-posted member discount (the stored military true comes from the Good Sam directory, not the operator). Older camper reports ($43 Jan 2023, $47-60 aggregators, $59 Dec 2020) are stale and not the operator's.

DROP CANDIDATE - ACCESS (probably a mis-tick, reviewer decides): the host's Hipcamp 'Things to know' reads '4WD required Park at your site.' (Hipcamp FAQ: 'How do you get to the sites at Big River RV Park? 4WD required.'). Imagery shows paved park roads off paved Marina St and big rigs throughout, so it looks like a wrong checkbox, but it is the operator's own statement.

LONG-STAY: Hipcamp sells 32 nightly sites against the stored 182 (~18%), and imagery shows many interior pads with sheds and shade structures. Inside the 10-50% caveat band; the note says many sites hold long-term units. No operator wording against nightly guests; one-night minimum on every site; no age rule seen. A camper report (Feb 2022) priced 28 days at $375 + electric.

WATERFRONT riverfront KEPT: the front row of pads sits on the open California shore of the Colorado (~250 m wide), ~5-15 m from the water with private docks and moored boats beside the pads, no trees or road between - e.g. around 34.1272,-114.3592 and 34.1262,-114.3604. Hipcamp sells them as 'River Sites Full Hookups' (10 sites, $73, 45 ft); site numbers are not published. Bank height not measurable, but boats tied at the pad-side docks point to a low bank. Proposed evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-27: front row of pads on the open Colorado River shore ~5-15 m from water with docks alongside (34.1272,-114.3592 / 34.1262,-114.3604); Hipcamp River Sites Full Hookups sold nightly.'
